start: Settings, Backup and restore, MettleUp account card, signed in with Google, the server copy holds workouts this phone lacks

steps.action: Open Settings, Backup and restore; find the card 'Keep your workouts on MettleUp'
must_not: The button missing for a signed-in member

user_sees: The background copy waits while the copy is read
must_not: A second bring-back running at the same time
Workouts sent up before the server copy is in

steps.action: Wait for the copy to be read and merged
user_sees: '<n> workouts brought back to this phone.'
must_not: The same workout shown twice in History
An older server edit overwriting a newer edit made on this phone

user_sees: The brought-back workouts, with their records worked out again
must_not: Old screens that need an app restart to show the new workouts

start: Welcome screen on a new phone, member had saved workouts on MettleUp before

steps.action: Tap 'Continue with Google' and pick the same Google account
must_not: Workouts of this phone sent before the server copy is read

steps.action: Wait while the copy is read
user_sees: '<n> workouts brought back to this phone.'
The app opens on the member's own profile when the copy holds one
must_not: The 3 setup questions asked again when the profile came back
Duplicate workouts after the profile is set up and the copy is merged a second time

start: Signed-in phone right after a Google Drive restore replaced the data (bring-back pending)

steps.action: Restore an older Drive backup, then use the app normally
user_sees: No message; the next background copy brings the server copy in first
must_not: The restored older rows deleting or overwriting newer workouts on the server

steps.action: Open History after a minute online
user_sees: Workouts saved on the server after the Drive backup was made are back too
must_not: Workouts lost because the restore was older

start: A workout is in progress; Settings, MettleUp account card

user_sees: 'Finish your workout first, then try again.'
must_not: The bring-back running and replacing exercises under the open workout

start: Phone holds the demo data, or the phone is offline

steps.action: With demo data on the phone, tap 'Bring back my workouts'
user_sees: 'This phone has the demo data. Remove it first (Settings → "Erase or start over"), then try again.'
must_not: Demo workouts mixed into the member's real copy

steps.action: On a phone with real data, turn the internet off and tap again
user_sees: 'No internet right now. Your workouts are safe on this phone. Try again when you are online.'
must_not: A success line when nothing was read
Any workout on the phone changed

start: Settings, MettleUp account card, right after a bring-back that worked

steps.action: Tap 'Bring back my workouts' a second time
must_not: Workouts added a second time
A count of workouts brought back that are already on the phone

steps.action: Edit a workout on this phone, then tap 'Bring back my workouts'
must_not: The older server version replacing the edit made on this phone

start: Phone with another person's workouts, Settings, sign in with a different Google account

steps.action: Tap 'Continue with Google' and pick a different Google account than the one these workouts were saved under
user_sees: 'This phone has another person’s workouts. To use a different Google account, first erase this phone in Settings → "Erase or start over".'
must_not: One person's workouts merged into, or sent to, another person's account
Another member's or the gym's eyes on the brought-back copy
